title: Mameshiba Characters Get Oyatsushiba Spinoff Short Net Anime
content: Kim Sukwon's Mameshiba character franchise is inspiring a spinoff short net anime titled Oyatsushiba that will premiere on YouTube on Friday, November 14 at 6:00 p.m. (4:00 a.m. EST). There are 20 weekly episodes, each about one minute long, in what the staff describes as the "first batch" for Oyatsushiba .
author: ANN

title: Spy×Family Anime Gets 4th Season, Theatrical Film in 2027
content: The staff for the Spy×Family anime announced on Sunday the anime is receiving a fourth season as well as a new film in theaters in Japan in 2027. The staff also revealed a visual for the fourth season: The first anime season's first half premiered in April 2022, and the second half premiered in October 2022.
author: ANN

title: Tekken 8 Game Streams Roger Jr. Starter Guide
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment started streaming a starter guide video for Roger Jr., one of the characters for the Tekken 8 fighting game's Season 3 , on Tuesday ahead of the character's early access release on Wednesday.
author: ANN

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Tag Force GX Game Previews Duels, Partners, Multiplayer, Exploration in New Trailer
content: Konami streamed a new gameplay trailer for its Yu-Gi-Oh! Tag Force GX game , an updated version of the 2008 Yu-Gi-Oh! GX Tag Force 3 game, on Tuesday. The trailer previews the duels, partner system, online multiplayer, and town exploration gameplay.
author: ANN

title: Dragon Ball Still Has More to Explore With Raditz & The Saiyan Needs a Chance
content: Redemption is a hallmark of the Dragon Ball franchise, and so many capitalized on their second chances with Raditz being no different. The brother of Goku and the son of Bardock came to Earth with destruction in mind alongside fellow Saiyans, Vegeta and Nappa.
author: ComicBook

title: WEBTOON Reports US$9.23 Million in 3rd Quarter of 2026
content: The company's net loss shrank to US$7.5 million from US$11.1 million a year earlier. WEBTOON said that the improvement came from higher gross profit and an income tax benefit, partially offset by heavier marketing spending and bigger foreign currency losses.
author: ANN

title: HIDIVE to Release Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery Film in 2027 With N. American Premiere Screening at Anime Frontier on December 5
content: HIDIVE announced on Tuesday that it will distribute Made in Abyss : Awakening Mystery ( Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi ), the first film in the new Made in Abyss anime film series , in 2027.
author: ANN

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Is Avoiding The Legend of Korra’s Biggest Mistake
content: Avatar: Seven Havens has wrapped up the first season of its run with Paramount+, and the producers behind it all have revealed how the series is set to avoid The Legend of Korra ‘s biggest mistake thanks to having a full plan laid out in mind.
author: ComicBook

title: After 5 Years, Dandadan Finally Reveals Okarun’s Tragic Origin Story
content: DAN DA DAN has been working its way through one of its most divisive arcs for the past few months, and it has all led to the reveal of Okarun’s truly heartbreaking origin story after five long years.
author: ComicBook
